logline: 시골에서 올라온 젊은이가 하루 만에 세 사람과 결투를 약속하고, 그 셋과 한편이 된다.
destination: 왕비의 목걸이가 걸린 영국행 — 넷이 함께 달려야 하는 길
protagonist: 낡은 가죽조끼에 깃털 모자를 쓴 열여덟 시골 청년
anchor: an eighteen-year-old lean youth with a feathered hat, worn leather jerkin and high boots
palette: Paris slate grey, candle amber, wine red, steel glint

beats.beat: 청년이 여윈 말을 끌고 파리 골목에 들어선다.
beats.visual: a young man leading a bony yellow horse into a crowded narrow Paris street, shutters above
beats.motion: he leads the horse forward down the street, laundry flaps overhead, crowds part

beats.beat: 청년이 어깨를 부딪친 사내와 마주 선다.
beats.visual: a young man squared off against a tall musketeer in a doorway after a collision
beats.motion: the two turn toward each other, a cloak swings back, a hat brim tips up

beats.beat: 수도원 뒤뜰에 네 사람이 모여 선다.
beats.visual: four men gathered in a walled convent yard, three musketeers facing one young stranger
beats.motion: they step into a loose ring, cloaks swing off shoulders, dust lifts underfoot

beats.visual: red-cloaked guards striding through a convent gate toward four waiting men
beats.motion: the guards push in through the gate toward them, cloaks stream back, gravel scatters

beats.beat: 네 자루의 칼이 한꺼번에 뽑혀 나온다.
beats.visual: four rapiers drawn together in a walled yard, blades caught in slanting light
beats.motion: the blades come up together toward the guards, sunlight runs along the steel

beats.beat: 네 사람이 밤길을 나란히 말을 몰아 달린다.
beats.visual: four riders galloping abreast down a moonlit country road, cloaks streaming behind
beats.motion: the horses drive forward toward the camera, cloaks stream back, dust boils up

beats.visual: a young man seizing a mooring rope at a windy night harbor, a ship straining beyond
beats.motion: the rope snaps taut in his hands, the ship pulls away from the quay, spray flies

beats.beat: 빈 부두에 깃털 모자 하나만 뒹군다.
beats.visual: an empty stone quay at dawn with a fallen feathered hat, mooring ropes trailing in water
beats.motion: wind rolls the hat along the quay, ropes drag in the water, gulls wheel overhead

withheld: 목걸이를 둘러싼 계략의 결말과, 네 사람이 치르게 되는 대가
